ja: 自分の手で恐竜を“知りつくす”ブランド『プラノサウルス』第６弾に、白亜紀の重戦車「アンキロサウルス」が登場！
• 「骨格ビルド」で恐竜の内部構造から知ることができる。
• 「恐竜ビルド」で骨格の上から外皮パーツを取り付けるプラモデルならではの仕様で恐竜の姿を復元。
• ニッパー等の道具や接着剤が必要ないから簡単に組み立てられる。
• 全身を覆う特徴的な装甲は、近縁の鎧竜を参考に配列パターンを再現。
• 襲ってくるティラノサウルスの脛の骨を砕くことが可能だったと考えられている尾の先端のハンマー状の突起も忠実に再現。
• 尾の先端の骨塊に繋がる骨質の腱の造形も表現。
• アンキロサウルスの特徴的な隙間のない堅牢な頭骨を忠実に再現。
• 口の開閉や前肢、後肢、首など各所が可動し、好みのポージングでディスプレイが可能。
en: The Cretaceous heavy tank "Ankylosaurus" appears in the 6th edition of "Planosaurus", a brand that lets you "know everything about dinosaurs" with your own hands!
• "Skeleton Build" allows you to learn about the internal structure of dinosaurs.
• "Dinosaur Build" allows you to restore the dinosaur's appearance using specifications unique to plastic models, where the skin parts are attached to the top of the skeleton.
• Easy to assemble as there is no need for tools such as nippers or adhesives.
• The distinctive armor that covers the entire body reproduces the arrangement pattern based on the closely related armored dragon.
• The hammer-shaped protrusion at the tip of the tail, which is thought to have been able to crush the shin bones of attacking Tyrannosaurus, is also faithfully reproduced.
• It also depicts the bony tendon that connects to the bony mass at the tip of the tail.
• Faithfully reproduces the characteristic solid skull of Ankylosaurus with no gaps.
• Various parts such as the opening and closing of the mouth, front legs, hind legs, and neck can be moved, allowing you to display your favorite poses.
